format: claude_head_to_head is the opposite side of kiley's 8 pregame coin flips on the identical Kalshi market, so exactly one side wins each. players.claude is Claude's separate 9-game moneyline card.
scoring: Each pick stores cost (price paid) and pays_per_100, so the card scores in dollars at $100 flat per pick as well as by record.
claude_spreads_method: Rung chosen as the spread closest to 50% (within 3c) with a book no wider than 3c; the SIDE is then decided by a seeded coin toss (seed 20260919), not chosen by Claude. Games with no rung near 50% are skipped rather than forced. Replaces an earlier version that took the side nearest the 53% cap and so never held a pick priced under even money.
